astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: NGC 3660 and Burçin's Galaxy
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: The upper galaxy might be more photogenic, but the lower galaxy is more unusual.  The galaxy up top is NGC 3660, a spiral galaxy similar to our own Milky Way galaxy in that it has several bright blue spiral arms and a central bar of stars, dust, and gas. Captured by chance in the featured deep and colorful image, surprisingly, is SN 2026cff, a supernova found just to the right of the central bar. …
